image_description: A grey whale is partially submerged in calm blue water, with its head and upper back visible above the surface. The background features a hazy, distant shoreline or mountain range under a pale sky. The whale's skin appears dark grey with lighter mottling.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visible but angled away and partially submerged; blowholes are not clearly distinguishable due to resolution and angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible skin shows characteristic mottling and lighter patches consistent with barnacle/lice coverage.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the back shows no dorsal fin and hints at the knuckled ridge typical of grey whales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the anterior section is visible; full body shape cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with Head_and_Face observation; mottling is evident on visible back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Mouth is closed/submerged; baleen plates are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are submerged and not visible in this view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Tail is completely out of frame/submerged.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible skin texture appears rough and uneven, consistent with callosities/barnacles.
